source.label: Silverball Rules Voltan Escapes Cosmic Doom strategy

supportingSources.label: Bally Voltan confirmed factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Voltan builds end-of-ball bonus by collecting planets 1 through 9. Completing A-B-C-D lights 3x bonus; A-B also lights both spinners for 1,000 per spin, while C-D lights the center bumper for 1,000. Completing the planet set once lights Jumbo Bonus and a second time lights Super Bonus. The controlled route is to use the spinners for upper-playfield access and attempt planets 3 and 7 through their return lanes only when a tested Shatz pass is safe.
strategy.simpleOverview: Collect planets 1 through 9 to build bonus. Complete A-B-C-D to light 3x; A-B lights both spinners for 1,000 per spin, and C-D lights the center bumper for 1,000. The first complete planet set lights Jumbo Bonus and the second lights Super Bonus. Shoot through the spinners, and use a Shatz pass for return-lane planets 3 and 7 only when that transfer is safe.
strategy.summary: Favor the two spinners because they feed the upper lanes and avoid direct center-target rebounds. Build A-B-C-D and the easy planets first; planets 3 and 7 are the limiting return-lane switches, so test one low-force Shatz before relying on that route.

quickInfo.name: Light Jumbo and Super
quickInfo.summary: Complete the planet set once, then a second time.

steps.text: Shoot through either spinner to feed the top lanes and collect planets 1, 4, 6, and 9.
Complete A-B-C-D to light 3x bonus; A-B lights the spinners and C-D lights the center bumper.
Collect center planets 2, 5, and 8 only from controlled feeds or when one hit finishes the set.
Test a low-force Shatz pass for return-lane planets 3 and 7; stop using it if the ball can cross into an outlane.
Complete all nine planets once for Jumbo Bonus and again for Super Bonus, then protect the multiplied end-of-ball value.

alternatives.title: Seven-planet route
alternatives.when: Use this when planets 3 and 7 cannot be collected safely through the return lanes.

steps.text: Use the spinners and upper play to collect planets 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 9.
Preserve that reliable multiplied bonus instead of forcing an unsafe return-lane transfer.
Complete planets 1 through 9 once to light Jumbo Bonus.
Complete the planet set again to light Super Bonus, then protect the ball.

machineSetup: Test all nine planet switches, A-B-C-D switches and lamps, both spinners, the center bumper, top lanes, three center standups, both return lanes, outlanes, center Extra Ball target, and the Jumbo, Super, and 3x bonus lamps.

Confirm three- or five-ball play, Special and Extra Ball conversion to points, one-Extra-Ball limit, completed-set behavior, and whether either return lane can support a Shatz pass without carrying into its adjacent outlane.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: Use a low-force Shatz pass into return-lane planet 3 or 7 only after testing that the ball exits onto the opposite flipper instead of continuing into the adjacent outlane.

cautions.issue: The factory cards provide distinct replay, point-substitute, and Extra Ball rules.
cautions.response: Check the installed card before play; Special, completed-set, and center-target awards vary, while the planet and A-B-C-D qualification routes remain stable.
